head_commit.message:
fix(desktop): reject stale server-market manifests before install

When a server-market install/update is approved from a detail view,
the Renderer passes the manifest it displayed as expectedManifest, but
the install path ignored it and forwarded the freshly refetched
compatible.manifest as reviewedManifest.  If the market returned the
same releaseId with a changed manifest between review and install, the
new permissions would be treated as already reviewed.

Now compare ghostPermissionBaselineKey between expectedManifest and
freshly-fetched compatible.manifest before calling installDetail.
Validate expectedManifest first (via validateGhostManifest) so a
malformed renderer payload crashes with PRECONDITION_FAILED instead
of TypeError→INTERNAL from slots.includes deref.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: Yuewei-LL <308228674+Yuewei-LL@users.noreply.github.com>

head_commit.message:
fix(desktop): scope target invalid-id recovery gate to pending IDs

An unrelated broken directory in the target owner root (e.g. an
installed plugin whose ghost.json was accidentally corrupted) would
permanently block ALL legacy recovery for that owner via
discoveryHasInvalid / targetDiscovery.invalidIds — with canRetry:false
and no self-healing path.

The  set is deterministic (missing/broken ghost.json), unlike
 (transient I/O that self-heals on retry).  Scoping the
invalid gate to  (already filtered by
recoveryMarker.pendingIds at declaration) keeps the fail-closed
semantics for pending recovery targets while letting unrelated
target-root entries through.

Leave  unscoped: transient target-entry I/O that defers
the run is safe — the occupiedCommands gate correctly depends on
targetDiscovery.ghosts (not deferred entries), and deferred runs that
see a partial command projection must not proceed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: Yuewei-LL <308228674+Yuewei-LL@users.noreply.github.com>

head_commit.message:
fix(desktop): canonicalize test temp root to match production realpathSync.native

GH Windows runners expose os.tmpdir() as an 8.3 short path
(C:\Users\RUNNER~1\...) while GhostManager.assertManagedRootPath
resolves roots via fs.realpathSync.native (C:\Users\runneradmin\...).
This made every test's path-keyed spy predicate silently mismatch —
error injections never fired — and GhostManager.test.ts failed 10+ tests
on Windows CI but passed on Linux and developer machines.

Fix: canonicalize the temp workDir with fs.realpathSync.native so
test-built paths match what production passes to fs.  Also canonicalize
the two reapprove temp roots at lines ~980 and ~1020.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: Yuewei-LL <308228674+Yuewei-LL@users.noreply.github.com>

head_commit.message:
fix(desktop): bound release-marker reads in crossProcessLock

hasValidGateReleaseMarker used unbounded fsp.readFile on the
.released sidecar marker.  A FIFO/symlink/oversize file at this
path could block Ghost projection lock acquisition/release or
allocate unbounded memory.

Replace with readBoundedFileNoFollow (4 KiB + no-follow +
containWithin on realpath'd gate dir + nonBlocking: true),
matching the pattern already applied to readLockRecord.

head_commit.message:
fix(desktop): bound async legacy recovery marker reads

readLegacyGhostRecoveryMarker (async) used unbounded deps.readFile.
After the sync variant was hardened, the async path called from
recoverLegacyGhostPlugins() and acknowledgeRecoveredLegacyGhosts()
still followed a FIFO/symlink or allocated unbounded memory for
a corrupt .legacy-ghost-recovery-v1.json marker.

Replace with readBoundedFileNoFollow (64 KiB + no-follow +
containWithin on owner root realpath), matching the sync variant.
Non-file / oversize markers return deferred.

head_commit.message:
fix(desktop): bound legacy recovery marker reads

readLegacyGhostRecoveryMarkerSync used unbounded fsSync.readFileSync
on the recovery marker.  A FIFO or symlink to a huge file at
.legacy-ghost-recovery-v1.json could block the Main process or allocate
unbounded memory during getLegacyGhostRecoveryStatus() startup path.

Replace with readBoundedFileNoFollowSync (64 KiB limit + no-follow +
containWithin on the owner root's realpath), matching the same pattern
used for receipts, migration ledgers, and pending mutation journals.
Non-file / oversize markers now return 'deferred' instead of blocking.

head_commit.message:
fix(desktop): pass allowSourceReplacement on confirmed batch installs

The IPC handler now requires allowSourceReplacement to be a boolean
for every plugin-market:install call.  The confirmed batch expansion
path (approveUpdateExpansion) and the no-expansion recomputed path
both called installOrHoldForReReview without it, so user-approved
batch updates failed with INVALID_PARAMS.

Fix: add allowSourceReplacement: false to both paths (batch updates
never replace a source — only the detail-page explicit-replace flow
sets it to true).  Update 8 test assertions accordingly.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: Yuewei-LL <308228674+Yuewei-LL@users.noreply.github.com>

head_commit.message:
fix(desktop): pass allowSourceReplacement on confirmed batch installs

The IPC handler now requires allowSourceReplacement to be a boolean
for every plugin-market:install call.  The confirmed batch expansion
path (approveUpdateExpansion) and the no-expansion recomputed path
both called installOrHoldForReReview without it, so user-approved
batch updates failed with INVALID_PARAMS.

Fix: add allowSourceReplacement: false to both paths (batch updates
never replace a source — only the detail-page explicit-replace flow
sets it to true).  Update 8 test assertions accordingly.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: Yuewei-LL <308228674+Yuewei-LL@users.noreply.github.com>

head_commit.message:
fix(desktop): skip ghost skill reconcile when signed out

When dataOwnerId is null (signed-out / no-token startup), the reconcile
passed '' into withGhostSkillProjectionReconcile which rejects empty
owners outright.  The error message didn't match any retry condition so
skillReconcilePending was cleared without ever retrying, leaving managed
skill links from the previous owner in ~/.agents/skills across sign-out.

Teardown already calls removeGhostSkillLinksForRoots before reconcile
runs; a signed-out session has no owner to project.  Skip the reconcile
early — skillReconcilePending is already false inside the while body
so no pending state is lost.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: Yuewei-LL <308228674+Yuewei-LL@users.noreply.github.com>

head_commit.message:
Merge branch 'main' (30564c785) into redo/plugin-approval-receipt-migration

Keep HEAD's legacy ghost discovery infrastructure (scanLegacyGhostDirsInRoots,
LegacyGhostDiscovery, recovery marker) which is the PR's core migration
hardening.  origin/main's PR #2366 simplified the same functions; the two
are not compatible.  HEAD's rejectReservedIds support already handles the
official-id filtering.

Tests: keep HEAD's extra recovery regression tests, align expectations
with HEAD implementation.
